name: swag-labs-playwright
description: Playwright test automation framework for Swag Labs demo site
author: Adam Rynczak

scripts.test:visual:update:linux: tmp_docker_config=$(mktemp -d) && printf '{"auths":{}}' > "$tmp_docker_config/config.json" && DOCKER_CONFIG="$tmp_docker_config" docker run --rm --ipc=host -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.57.0-noble /bin/bash -lc "npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run test:visual:update"; status=$?; rm -rf "$tmp_docker_config"; exit $status
